model: Advanced Thermal Hydronics (Hydrotherm) KN-2 / KN-4 via BASgatewayLX
applies_to: Hydrotherm / Advanced Thermal Hydronics KN-2 and KN-4 modular boilers with the KN boiler-room controller on Modbus, read by a BASgatewayLX.
summary: Gateway profile for the Hydrotherm KN-2/KN-4 boiler system: 674 objects (112 AI, 18 AO, 544 BI), 57 polled by default. Writable objects cover heat demand, setpoint, outdoor-reset curve and DHW setpoint; the inputs give header, supply, return and outside temperatures, boilers on, modulation and a block of status bits per member boiler (only boiler 1 is polled by default).
notes: Built from Contemporary Controls' BASgatewayLX Modbus device profile Hydrotherm_KN2_KN4_aRY_Boiler_a_LX.csv; the profile maps the registers in the KN series Modbus manual (KNSLM) (https://www.ccontrols.com/support/dp/KNSLM.pdf).
Object instances are the ones this profile assigns when it is loaded into the gateway. A site that edited or rebuilt the profile may use different instances.
Only 57 of the 674 rows are flagged for polling in the profile; the rest are served only after you tick them in the gateway. Their descriptions say "not polled by default".

The CSV has no read/write column: Analog/Binary Inputs are read-only and Analog/Binary Outputs are commandable (priority array), which is how the gateway maps them (access inferred). Descriptions give the Modbus register each object reads.

integration.summary: Write HeatDemand and the setpoint, then read header/supply temperatures, boilers on and modulation. Enable the status bits for each member boiler you have.
setup: The BASgatewayLX presents each Modbus device as its own virtual BACnet device on BACnet IP; give it a unique device instance and Modbus address (serial) or IP address (Modbus TCP) when you add it with this profile.
One BASgatewayLX handles up to 100 Modbus devices and 1000 polled points in total, so leave unneeded rows unpolled.
gotchas: SetpointTimer (AO 2, seconds) sits next to the setpoint in the profile; check the KN manual for how it limits a BMS setpoint before relying on it.
Member boilers 2-16 repeat boiler 1's status block at higher instances; they are unpolled by default.
Unpolled rows do not appear as BACnet objects until enabled in the gateway's device profile page.
